risks.title: Confirmed FName native-constructor mismatch
risks.finding: Retained Function<FName(const CharType*, EFindName)> sends string in RDI and mode in ESI, receives packed return RAX; it supplies no writable output pointer and shifts mode/string roles.
risks.action: Use local native constructor ABI thunk with explicit writable 8-byte output, const char16_t* UTF-16 input, int32 mode. Preserve retained Function<FName(const CharType*, EFindName)> API and symbol identity.

risks.title: Other game signatures are unvalidated
risks.finding: Compiler lowering proves caller expectations, not target ABI. Slot/profile signatures and real parameter layouts must agree before treating any family as game-ABI validated. This audit newly validates no game target other than the locally saved constructor evidence.

risks.title: FName trivialness and nontrivial return drift
risks.finding: Selected FName is size8 and trivially copyable/destructible. Four compiled entries return FName in RAX (constructor wrapper, FProperty::GetID, UObject::GetExporterName, UStruct::FindPropertyNameFromGuid). Introducing nontrivial copy/move/destruction would change these to hidden-result/invisible-reference conventions and also affect by-value FName parameters and aggregate FPrimaryAssetId/FGuid pathways. Size alone is not enough to establish ABI.

risks.title: Placeholder structured-archive/delegate-sensitive declarations
risks.finding: UObject::FStructuredArchive::FRecord and FProperty::FStructuredArchive::FSlot are empty enums (lowered i32); FPropertyTag is void*. The game uses must be confirmed before invoking these wrappers. FScriptDelegate/FMulticastScriptDelegate and FURL value parameters lower as invisible-reference pointers due to selected nontrivial types; matching game trivialness is unconfirmed.

risks.title: Explicit UTF-16 boundary form still required
risks.finding: Current pinned target is width-correct: wchar_t=2, CharType=wchar_t, TCHAR=2, STR=L. This corrects a generic host wchar_t=4 assumption. Existing L/STR boundary expressions remain inventoried; literal width correctness does not make wchar_t* an explicit char16_t* API. Use per-boundary char16_t/u adaptation; do not globally FORCE_U16 because retained compiled symbol/API identities would drift.

risks.title: FName plain-string byte count bug outside direct-call ABI
risks.finding: GetPlainNameString copies String.size()*sizeof(File::StringType::size_type) (8-byte size_type) into a TCHAR buffer (2-byte element) rather than character bytes. This is a separate existing memory-copy risk, not evidence of a 4-byte pointer crossing.

non_engine_dispatch_notes.finding: Selected implementation traverses UE4SS object arrays/names locally. No native StaticFindObject Function target exists here; FName constructors underneath are native crossings.
Project pseudo-virtual dispatch and local object-searcher function pointer are UE4SS-to-UE4SS calls; game vtable loads use UnrealVirtualBaseVC macro entries inventoried above.

Generated std::function-typed layout getters exist, but audit found no selected call through UClass ClassConstructor/ClassVTableHelper getters. FFieldClass direct ConstructFn call is inventoried separately; returning a getter is not invoking its target.
